standing_rule_adopted: any check whose RESULT is reported — a reproduction check, a corroboration, a count of agreements — retains its query and its response verbatim, hashed and timestamped, at the moment it runs. A result reported without its artifact is a number quoted from memory, which lesson 29 already forbade for nulls and which applies identically here.

the_original_check.also_claimed: 1 stored game (mlb:LAD@COL) absent from the returned list
the_original_check.claimed_result: 14 of 14 search-returned scores match the stored rows exactly, 0 disagreements
the_original_check.consequence: the original claim cannot be verified by anyone, including me.

the_reproduction_attempt.query: MLB August 18 2026 final scores all games
the_reproduction_attempt.what_happened: the same class of query run today returns link titles only. Not one game score for 2026-08-18 appears anywhere in the response. So the check does not merely lack a hash — it does not reproduce. Search responses are not stable objects; the earlier response existed, and it is gone.

what_this_does_and_does_not_change.provenance: unaffected. It was never provenance and is not now. Tier-1 provenance still requires a retrieved artifact with a game id, a retrieval timestamp and a content hash.
what_this_does_and_does_not_change.the_14_of_14_claim: WITHDRAWN AS EVIDENCE. It stays in the record as something I said, labelled unreproducible. It may not be cited again in support of the canonical pool.
what_this_does_and_does_not_change.the_prior_pool: still PROVISIONAL at 1,684 rows, of which 1,620 carry no evidence path.
what_this_does_and_does_not_change.the_stored_scores: unchanged. Nothing here suggests the 2026-08-18 rows are wrong, and nothing here is licence to change them.

why_this_record_exists: I reported '2026-08-18: 14 of 14 stored scores match, 0 disagreements' and retained nothing. The owner is right that a claim of that shape needs its own artifact: without the exact query, the exact response, a timestamp and a hash, '14/14 matched' is not independently reproducible even as non-provenance evidence. It is a number I asked the reader to take on trust.
